_comment: External application: CoreWeave, Monolith team (Physical AI), London.
The posting's two centres of gravity are (1) ML on complex physical systems and (2) owning a
problem from framing through production. The selection leans on the ICCR doctorate for (1)
— synchrotron micro-CT lab data, Petrobras-funded — and on the thaw slump project for (2).
KNOWN GAPS, named in letter.json ¶6 rather than written around: no live, customer-facing
production service (monitoring, on-call, MLOps around a running system); no industrial
anomaly detection or reliability modelling; no time inside an industrial or product team.
`meta.company` names the team so 'Monolith' is filtered out of the gap scan as the employer's
own name rather than reported as a capability the candidate lacks.

meta.note: London, UK. Posting pasted by the candidate; no URL.

_comment_publications: Three first-author items: the core deep-learning method (RSE), foundation-model tooling
(IJAEOG 2026), and CNN segmentation of 4D synchrotron micro-CT from core-flooding
experiments — the one publication that is ML on physical lab data, which is Monolith's
territory. yang2022fast is a preprint and renders with its Authorea venue, as it should.
